top_findings.title: In-memory SQLite pool serves a separate empty database per connection under concurrency
top_findings.evidence: src/main.rs:80 SqlitePool::connect("sqlite::memory:") with sqlx 0.8.6 default max_connections=10; table created once at src/main.rs:84 (init_db) on a single connection, but each additional pooled connection to sqlite::memory: is a SEPARATE database with no 'books' table -> intermittent 'no such table: books' / lost data once a second connection is spun up under load. Graded tests never hit this (each test at src/tests.rs runs sequential queries on one reused connection).
top_findings.suggestion: Set max_connections(1) for the in-memory pool, or use a shared cache (sqlite::memory:?cache=shared with a keep-alive connection), or connect to a file-backed sqlite:books.db so all connections see the same schema/data.
